title: A qcqs scheme covered by quasi-affine basic opens is quasi-affine
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact (every open covering has a finite subcover) and quasi-separated (the intersection of any two affine open subschemes is quasi-compact). Let $I$ be a set and let $f_i\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ for $i\in I$. Put $X_{f_i}=\{x\in X:(f_i)_x\in\mathcal O_{X,x}^{\times}\}$, with its open subscheme structure [def-weil-open-immersion]. Assume $X=\bigcup_{i\in I}X_{f_i}$ and each $X_{f_i}$ is quasi-affine, meaning isomorphic to a quasi-compact open subscheme of an affine scheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $X$ is quasi-affine. The empty scheme and the empty index set are allowed.
